1: Write in English.
   2: 
   3: _A/B pair 06 (wave 29c): this brief is a verbatim copy of `.collab/nonblocking-2026-09-26/handoffs/06-claude-wave25-acceptance.md` of an earlier task, re-asked against the CURRENT tree. Answer its numbered questions against the code as it is now; where the brief names a commit range or a file that no longer matches, say so and answer on the current code._
   4: 
   5: # Wave 25 - acceptance brief: non-blocking consultation (R12) and the harness scripts override (T4)
   6: 
   7: Commit under review: 53de158 (main, 0.5.0 candidate). Design: handoffs/01-claude-r12-design.md;
   8: binding decisions D1-D12: handoffs/05-claude-r12-decisions.md (F02-1..11 of this task). The CHANGELOG
   9: `[0.5.0]` wave 25 entry and README "Non-blocking consultation" are the implementer's report.
  10: 
  11: ## What wave 25 claims
  12: 
  13: 1. `-Detach` (single run or `-Panel`): the foreground runs the dry-run checks PLUS every refusal a
  14:    real run makes before the lock (launchers, active recovery record, preflight, roster, the `.cmd`
  15:    `%` hazard), resolves brief/artifacts/collab dir to absolute paths, writes the `starting` status
  16:    record (no pid), and starts one hidden background bridge process (ShellExecute of cmd, stdout+
  17:    stderr to the log; the arguments travel inside the `starting` record as base64 CLIXML, only
  18:    -Task/-CollabDir/-DetachId on the command line). The background self-reports {running, pid,
  19:    start_time, host, budget_sec}, runs the consultation in-process, updates members as they
  20:    start/finish/are blocked, and writes a terminal status on every exit path (`Stop-WithError`
  21:    hook + the script-scope finally).
  22: 2. `-Status [-Id <id8>]` (0 done ok, 1 done with failures, 2 running, 3 wait timeout, 4 ambiguous
  23:    or unknown id / refused option), `-Wait [-WaitTimeoutSec]` (default: the recorded budget),
  24:    `-Prune` (done and died older than 7 days); liveness by Test-PidAlive(pid, start_time) with
  25:    the host check; `codex-findings.ps1 -List` lines and the SessionStart phrase (running /
  26:    finished in 24 h / died).
  27: 3. Files `<task>/.consult.detached-<id8>.status.json` and `.log`, gitignored (`.consult.detached-*`),
  28:    ignored by the agy/muse collab snapshot through the `.consult.` prefix; UTF-8 log and status.
  29: 4. T4: `-ScriptsDir` / `CODEX_CONSULT_SCRIPTS_DIR` on run-all.ps1 and every harness.
  30: 5. Tests: `harness-detach` 46 (UNIT, IGNORE, REFUSE, SINGLE, PANEL, WAITTIME, AGY, REFUSEDBG,
  31:    KILL, FABRIC, OUTER, COLLIDE, CWD, ENC, T4, GUARD).
  32: 
  33: ## Declared deviations and residuals (judge them)
  34: 
  35: - `-Status -Id <id8>` instead of a positional id (a bare id would bind to -CollabDir; caught with
  36:   exit 4). The background arguments in the status record, not on the command line (8191-char
  37:   limit, quoting, pwsh date coercion). Launch via cmd ShellExecute because Start-Process with
  38:   redirection held the caller's pipe (13 s for a 12 s child). Exit 4 also covers "no such id".
  39:   "Died" also covers never-started and unreadable files. The foreground does not probe the task
  40:   lock (D2's benign window: exit 0 = started, not usable). Killing only the background process
  41:   leaves members running while -Status says died. macOS/Linux background (`nohup`) untested.
  42: 
  43: ## The ask
  44: 
  45: 1. F02-1..11: fixed / still open / accepted limitation, with the code location in 53de158.
  46: 2. New defects in the foreground validation, the background launch and its argument transport,
  47:    the status record's lifecycle (every exit path), liveness and the died/never-started
  48:    judgement, the exit codes, the log/summary equivalence, the panel member updates, the T4
  49:    plumbing. Cite lines. Say what you verified in code and what you inferred. Budget your time:
  50:    a review of one wave.
  51: 3. ACCEPT only if no blocker or major remains; HOLD names exactly what must change.

=== F02-1 [verified/major]
The design's claim that the detached status/log files are gitignored by the existing patterns is false at HEAD: .gitignore lists only .consult.lock, .consult.write.lock, .consult.pending.json and .consult.pending-*.json, so .consult.detached-<id8>.status.json and .log stay untracked and visible in every git status of a repo whose policy deliberately tracks .collab/.
LOC: .gitignore:23, .collab/nonblocking-2026-09-26/handoffs/01-claude-r12-design.md:
=== F02-2 [verified/major]
Foreground validation defined as everything a dry run does is not a superset of the real run's refusals: launcher-not-on-PATH checks and the active-recovery-record refusal are DryRun-skipped or report-only, and the task lock is never attempted, so -Detach can print success and exit 0 while the background is refused moments later.
LOC: plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult.ps1:1904, plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult.ps1:1201, plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult.ps1:1998, .collab/nonblocking-2026-09-26/handoffs/01-claude-r12-design.md:
=== F02-3 [verified/major]
The design gives no mechanism that writes a terminal status on every background exit path: Stop-WithError and the direct exit 0/1 sites bypass any maintain-the-status-file duty, so a background refused after start (lock, active record, launcher, store parse) leaves the file at starting/running forever and -Status then reports it died with a recovery message that is false (nothing was started, nothing to recover).
LOC: plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult-common.ps1:238, plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult.ps1:1516, plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult.ps1:3382, .collab/nonblocking-2026-09-26/handoffs/01-claude-r12-design.md:
=== F02-4 [verified/major]
-Wait's proposed default timeout (timeout + retries + 120 s) is one member's kill guard, not the run's budget: panels serialize same-endpoint members, so a legitimate panel outlives the default and -Wait exits 3 still running; moreover the proposed status schema has no field -Wait could read a default from.
LOC: plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult.ps1:1275, plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult-common.ps1:4865, .collab/nonblocking-2026-09-26/handoffs/01-claude-r12-design.md:
=== F02-5 [verified/major]
The status file's first-write ownership is unspecified and racy: the foreground writes state starting (it cannot know the background pid yet), and if the background's own first write lands first, a foreground write after Start-Process overwrites running with stale starting; a single run has no intermediate member updates, so the file can read starting until the terminal write, and a background that dies before its first write leaves a pid-less file whose liveness cannot be judged at all.
LOC: .collab/nonblocking-2026-09-26/handoffs/01-claude-r12-design.md:, plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult.ps1:1146
=== F02-6 [verified/major]
-List's new detached line and the SessionStart phrase read status files only, so a detached run whose background died keeps printing running indefinitely (and is never pruned, since -Prune deletes only done files) - the exact stale-liveness problem item 4 fixes for -Status is left open in the two surfaces a new session actually sees first.

The Q2 alternative the brief entertains (detached runs under the collab root's own directory) is unsafe at HEAD: Get-CollabSnapshot ignores .consult.-prefixed file names at any depth but skips only .git and reparse-point directories, so unprefixed files inside e.g. <collab>/.consult.detached/ would enter snapshots and fail a concurrently running agy member of any task.

The detached background parent would not set [Console]::OutputEncoding while panel members explicitly do it for redirected output, so on Windows PowerShell 5.1 the log file (and any summary text captured from it) is written in the OEM codepage and non-ASCII content mojibakes, breaking the verbatim-summary test.

=== F02-11 [verified/minor]
The design contradicts itself on writing (-Status -Wait take no lock and write nothing, yet -Status -Prune deletes files), does not say the background must be started with the foreground's working directory, and does not refuse -Detach together with the internal -PanelSpec: relative -Brief/-Artifact/-CollabDir resolve against callerCwd, so a background with a different cwd validates against the wrong files.
LOC: plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult.ps1:1876, .collab/nonblocking-2026-09-26/handoffs/01-claude-r12-design.md:
=== F07-1 [proposed/minor]
An unreadable status file (present but empty, unparseable, no id, bad state) is never pruned - -Status -Prune skips the `unreadable` judgement - and the SessionStart hook counts it in the died phrase indefinitely, so one corrupted file permanently degrades -Status (exit 1), -List and the hook with no cleanup path.
LOC: plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult.ps1:872, plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult-common.ps1:7230
=== F07-2 [proposed/minor]
After the 60-second grace a `starting` record without a pid is reported as never started with the categorical wording `nothing was run`, but a slow background (cold start, antivirus, >60 s host spin-up) may still self-report afterwards and turn the record into running - the transient judgement can state a falsehood and, in -Prune's view, mark the run prunable as never-started 7 days later even though it ran.
LOC: plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult-common.ps1:7166, plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult-common.ps1:6985
=== F07-3 [proposed/note]
The SessionStart hook now dot-sources the entire codex-consult-common.ps1 (~7,100 lines) in its own process on every session start, in addition to spawning codex-providers.ps1 - a small but permanent latency addition to every session for one phrase.
LOC: plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult-hook.ps1:90
=== F08-1 [proposed/minor]
Unreadable detached status files are reported as failures but are excluded from every pruneable state, so corrupt or truncated status and log files accumulate forever even though the declared deviation groups unreadable files under the died/never-started family.
LOC: plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult-common.ps1:7141, plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult.ps1:872
=== F08-2 [proposed/minor]
Status persistence is deliberately best-effort and both intermediate and final write errors are swallowed, so a successful detached run can exit 0 while its status remains running or starting and later appears died.
LOC: plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult.ps1:621, plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult.ps1:664
=== F10-1 [proposed/note]
Killing only the detached background panel parent process leaves its child member processes running, as documented.
LOC: 
=== F11-1 [proposed/minor]
A status file that matches the detached glob but cannot be parsed (or names no id / bad state) is judged 'unreadable' (exit 1), poisons every aggregate -Status/-Wait of the task, and can never be removed by -Status -Prune: the prune loop only deletes done/died/never-started, so the only recourse is deleting the file by hand.
LOC: plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult-common.ps1:7141, plugins/codex-consult/scripts/codex-consult.ps1:872
=== F11-2 [proposed/note]
The foreground's `starting` record embeds the background's full arguments (base64 CLIXML), including an inline -Prompt text, in a repo file; the background drops `args` at self-report, but if it never starts the arguments linger in the status file indefinitely (until manual deletion).
